description.default: The number of days to retain promoted error event records before the weekly Delete Old Errors maintenance flow removes them. Only records with a triage status of Fixed, Duplicate, Won't Fix, or Closed and an occurrence date older than this threshold are deleted. Unresolved records are never deleted by the maintenance flow. Set to 0 to disable automatic deletion. Default: 90.
